cases.name: built-in worked example
stdout: (no config - demo: an invented four-campaign account over 30 days, with its search terms and landing pages)
PAID SEARCH AUDIT - target CPA 250. Nothing here is a benchmark.
Setup: 6 of 9 in place
Account: 9,500 spend, 85 conversions, CPA 112; brand 9% of spend at CPA 15, non-brand CPA 344; 19% of spend in campaigns with no conversions
Brand [brand, manual]: 900 spend, 1500 clicks, 60 conv, CPA 15, CTR 30.0%, CVR 4.0%, lost to budget 2%, lost to rank 5%
Scheduling software [non-brand, target-cpa]: 4,200 spend, 700 clicks, 21 conv, CPA 200, CTR 3.3%, CVR 3.0%, lost to budget 35%, lost to rank 20%
Competitors [competitor, maximize-conversions]: 2,600 spend, 320 clicks, 4 conv, CPA 650, CTR 2.0%, CVR 1.3%, lost to budget 5%, lost to rank 50%
Generic contractor [non-brand, maximize-clicks]: 1,800 spend, 900 clicks, 0 conv, CPA -, CTR 1.5%, CVR 0.0%
Search terms: 8 rows, 4,880 spend; waste 1,480 (30%): 3 irrelevant, 0 zero-conversion; 2 winners not yet keywords
Landing pages: 3, median conversion rate 2.1%
FIXES - blocking first, then by spend affected
1. ! [campaigns, 2,600] Competitors converts at 650, more than twice your target. Fix the terms and page, or cut it.
2. ! [campaigns, 2,262] Scheduling software converts at 200 (under your 250 target) and loses 35% of impressions to budget. This is the cheapest growth in the account: move budget here.
3. ! [landing-pages, 2,200] /compare: the page does not repeat the ad's promise. Message mismatch is the most common reason a good keyword looks bad.
4. ! [campaigns, 1,800] Generic contractor: 1,800 spent, 900 clicks, no conversions. Pause or rebuild before anything else.

5. ! [search-terms, 1,480] 3 search terms match your irrelevant patterns and are not negated: "free scheduling app", "contractor jobs near me", "crew scheduling excel template". Add them to a shared negative list.
6. - [setup, 9,500] Not in place: CRM outcomes imported. Without qualified or closed-won imported from the CRM, the account optimises toward form fills, including the junk ones.
7. - [setup, 9,500] Not in place: Geo targeting: presence, not interest. The default includes people "interested in" your location; for a business that sells in one place, that is spend outside it.
8. - [setup, 9,500] Not in place: Shared negative lists. A negative added to one campaign does not protect the others; account-level lists do.
9. - [campaigns, 4,200] Scheduling software runs target-cpa on 21 conversions in the period. Below 30 (AAJ's rule) the algorithm is guessing; consolidate campaigns or bid manually until it has data.

10. - [campaigns, 2,600] Competitors runs maximize-conversions on 4 conversions in the period. Below 30 (AAJ's rule) the algorithm is guessing; consolidate campaigns or bid manually until it has data.
11. - [landing-pages, 2,200] /compare converts at 0.6%, under half the account's median page (2.1%). Check message match and the first screen.

12. - [search-terms] 2 converting search terms are not keywords: "hvac dispatch software" (3 conv), "plumbing dispatch app" (4 conv). Add them as exact-match keywords so you control the bid and the ad.
WASTE: 19% of spend is in campaigns with clicks and no conversions. Stop the waste before optimising anything.
